entries.title: Signing in to Copilot and Kimi Code takes one step
entries.body: The Copilot and Kimi Code buttons now show your sign-in code right away. One button copies the code and opens the page where you enter it. Copilot assumes github.com, with a Use GitHub Enterprise option. Cancel stops the sign-in at once, and an expired code offers a new one. Signing in again to a GitHub Enterprise account no longer asks for its address.

picture.alt: Settings, Intelligence, with a Copilot sign-in code, Copy code, a Copy code and open GitHub button, Cancel and Use GitHub Enterprise
